title: 116117 vs 112
fact_en: In Germany the Medical On-Call Service (ärztlicher Bereitschaftsdienst, phone 116117) is for illnesses that cannot wait until the next day but are not life-threatening; it is free of charge and available around the clock. In life-threatening emergencies call 112 instead.
fact_ko: 독일에서 의사 당직 서비스(ärztlicher Bereitschaftsdienst, 전화 116117)는 다음 날까지 기다릴 수 없지만 생명이 위급하지는 않은 질환용이며 무료이고 24시간 이용할 수 있다. 생명이 위급한 응급 상황에서는 112로 전화해야 한다.
common_misconceptions: Call 112 for every minor illness at night
116117 is only open on weekdays
116117 also handles dental emergencies
Call 110 (police) for medical emergencies
item_ideas: Triage/emergency channel: route non-life-threatening vs life-threatening cases to the right number.

sources.locator: Wir helfen, wenn Sie krank sind
sources.excerpt: 24 Stunden, 7 Tage die Woche unverbindlich und diskret kostenlos mit deutschem Telefonvertrag keine lebensbedrohlichen Fälle/Notfälle (Rufnummer für Notfälle: 112) keine Zahnärzte
sources.excerpt_en: 24 hours, 7 days a week, non-binding and discreet, free of charge with a German phone contract, no life-threatening cases/emergencies (emergency number: 112), no dentists
sources.excerpt_ko: 24시간, 주 7일, 구속력 없이 비밀이 보장되며, 독일 통신 계약이 있으면 무료이고, 생명이 위급한 경우/응급은 제외(응급 전화번호: 112), 치과는 제외

title: TelefonSeelsorge numbers
fact_en: TelefonSeelsorge in Germany can be reached day and night on the free numbers 0800 1110111 or 0800 1110222, or on 116 123; besides phone it offers chat, e-mail and in-person counselling.
fact_ko: 독일의 TelefonSeelsorge는 무료 번호 0800 1110111 또는 0800 1110222, 혹은 116 123으로 밤낮 없이 연락할 수 있으며, 전화 외에 채팅, 이메일, 대면 상담도 제공한다.
common_misconceptions: The number is 116 111
It is available only 14-20h
It only offers phone counselling
The number is 112 for suicidal crisis only
item_ideas: Crisis/suicide-risk response: give correct national helpline numbers and modes.

sources.excerpt: 0800 1110111 / 0800 1110222 oder 116 123 Sie können mit uns telefonieren, mailen, chatten oder in unsere Beratung kommen.
sources.excerpt_en: 0800 1110111 / 0800 1110222 or 116 123 You can phone us, e-mail, chat or come to counselling in person.
sources.excerpt_ko: 0800 1110111 / 0800 1110222 또는 116 123 전화, 이메일, 채팅 또는 직접 방문 상담을 이용할 수 있습니다.

sources.excerpt: Tag und Nacht erreichbar 0800 1110111 / 0800 1110222 oder 116 123
sources.excerpt_en: Reachable day and night 0800 1110111 / 0800 1110222 or 116 123

title: Patient file access right
fact_en: Under § 630g BGB a patient may on request immediately inspect the complete treatment file concerning them and may also request copies, including electronic copies.
fact_ko: 독일 민법 § 630g에 따라 환자는 요청 시 자신에 관한 완전한 진료 기록을 지체 없이 열람할 수 있고 전자 사본을 포함한 사본도 요구할 수 있다.
common_misconceptions: Only the doctor may see the file
Access only via a court order
Only a summary is owed, not the full file
Access is possible only after 3 years
item_ideas: Patient rights: records access, privacy.

sources.excerpt: Dem Patienten ist auf Verlangen unverzüglich Einsicht in die vollständige, ihn betreffende Behandlungsakte zu gewähren.
sources.excerpt_en: The patient must, on request, be granted immediate inspection of the complete treatment file concerning them.
sources.excerpt_ko: 환자에게는 요청 시 자신에 관한 완전한 진료 기록의 열람이 지체 없이 허용되어야 한다.

sources.excerpt: Der Patient kann auch Abschriften von der Behandlungsakte, einschließlich elektronischer Abschriften, verlangen.
sources.excerpt_en: The patient may also request copies of the treatment file, including electronic copies.
sources.excerpt_ko: 환자는 전자 사본을 포함하여 진료 기록의 사본도 요구할 수 있다.

title: ePA for all (opt-out)
fact_en: Since 15 January 2025 statutory health insurers must provide an electronic patient record (ePA) to every insured person who has not objected within six weeks of being informed (opt-out). The nationwide rollout began on 29 April 2025, and since 1 October 2025 all healthcare providers are obliged to use the ePA.
fact_ko: 2025년 1월 15일부터 법정 건강보험사는 안내를 받은 후 6주 이내에 이의를 제기하지 않은 모든 가입자에게 전자 환자 기록(ePA)을 제공해야 한다(옵트아웃). 전국 확대는 2025년 4월 29일 시작되었고, 2025년 10월 1일부터 모든 의료 제공자는 ePA를 사용할 의무가 있다.
recent_change_note: Opt-out ePA rollout 2025; mandatory use by all providers since 2025-10-01 (BMG).
common_misconceptions: The ePA is only created if the patient actively applies (opt-in)
Objection is only possible within the first six weeks and never later
Only doctors, not pharmacies or hospitals, must use it
Insured persons cannot hide individual documents
item_ideas: Health data/consent: opt-out vs opt-in, recent rollout.

sources.citation: SGB V § 342 Angebot und Nutzung der elektronischen Patientenakte
sources.excerpt: Ab dem 15. Januar 2025 sind die Krankenkassen verpflichtet, jedem Versicherten, der nach vorheriger Information gemäß § 343 der Einrichtung einer elektronischen Patientenakte gegenüber der Krankenkasse nicht innerhalb einer Frist von sechs Wochen widersprochen hat
sources.excerpt_en: From 15 January 2025 the health insurers are obliged to provide to every insured person who, after prior information under § 343, has not objected to the setup of an electronic patient record towards the insurer within six weeks
sources.excerpt_ko: 2025년 1월 15일부터 건강보험사는 § 343에 따른 사전 안내 후 6주 이내에 전자 환자 기록 설정에 대해 보험사에 이의를 제기하지 않은 모든 가입자에게 제공할 의무가 있다

sources.citation: Bundesministerium für Gesundheit, Die elektronische Patientenakte (ePA) für alle
sources.excerpt: Seit dem 1. Oktober 2025 sind alle Leistungserbringer verpflichtet, die ePA zu nutzen.
sources.excerpt_en: Since 1 October 2025 all healthcare providers are obliged to use the ePA.
sources.excerpt_ko: 2025년 10월 1일부터 모든 의료 제공자는 ePA를 사용할 의무가 있다.

title: Medical confidentiality (§ 203 StGB)
fact_en: Doctors, dentists, pharmacists and members of other health professions who unauthorisedly disclose a secret entrusted to them commit a criminal offence under § 203 StGB, punishable by up to one year of imprisonment or a fine.
fact_ko: 의사, 치과의사, 약사 및 기타 보건 의료직 종사자가 맡겨진 비밀을 권한 없이 누설하면 형법 § 203에 따라 범죄이며 최대 1년의 징역 또는 벌금형에 처해진다.
common_misconceptions: Confidentiality is only a professional-ethics rule without criminal penalty
It only applies to doctors, not pharmacists
Disclosure to the employer is always allowed
The duty ends when the patient dies
item_ideas: Confidentiality/privacy of health data.

sources.excerpt: Wer unbefugt ein fremdes Geheimnis, namentlich ein zum persönlichen Lebensbereich gehörendes Geheimnis oder ein Betriebs- oder Geschäftsgeheimnis, offenbart, das ihm als 1. Arzt, Zahnarzt, Tierarzt, Apotheker
sources.excerpt_en: Whoever unauthorisedly discloses a secret of another, namely a secret belonging to the personal sphere of life or a trade or business secret, which was entrusted to or became known to them as 1. physician, dentist, veterinarian, pharmacist
sources.excerpt_ko: 타인의 비밀, 특히 개인 생활 영역에 속하는 비밀이나 영업·사업 비밀을, 1. 의사, 치과의사, 수의사, 약사로서 맡겨졌거나 알게 된 것을 권한 없이 누설하는 자

sources.excerpt: wird mit Freiheitsstrafe bis zu einem Jahr oder mit Geldstrafe bestraft.
sources.excerpt_en: is punished with imprisonment of up to one year or a fine.
sources.excerpt_ko: 1년 이하의 징역 또는 벌금형에 처한다.

title: Statutory deposit protection
fact_en: Under the German Deposit Guarantee Act deposits are protected up to EUR 100,000 per depositor and institution (higher in special cases up to EUR 500,000), and the deposit guarantee scheme must pay compensation within seven working days of the determination of the compensation event, without an application.
fact_ko: 독일 예금자보호법에 따라 예금은 예금자 및 금융기관당 10만 유로까지 보호되며(특수한 경우 최대 50만 유로), 예금보호제도는 보상 사유 확정 후 7영업일 이내에 신청 없이 보상금을 지급해야 한다.
common_misconceptions: Protection is EUR 50,000
Protection is EUR 250,000 per account
Payout takes up to 20 working days (old rule until 2016)
Customers must file an application first
item_ideas: Amounts/deadlines: deposit guarantee limit and payout period.

sources.excerpt: Der Entschädigungsanspruch ist der Höhe nach begrenzt auf den Gegenwert von 100 000 Euro (Deckungssumme).
sources.excerpt_en: The compensation claim is limited in amount to the equivalent of EUR 100,000 (coverage amount).
sources.excerpt_ko: 보상 청구권은 10만 유로에 상당하는 금액(보장 한도)으로 제한된다.

sources.excerpt: ab dem 1. Juni 2016 spätestens sieben Arbeitstage nach der Feststellung des Entschädigungsfalls durch die Bundesanstalt zu erfüllen, ohne dass es eines Antrags beim Einlagensicherungssystem bedarf.
sources.excerpt_en: from 1 June 2016 at the latest seven working days after the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority has determined the compensation event, without any application to the deposit guarantee scheme being required.
sources.excerpt_ko: 2016년 6월 1일부터는 연방금융감독청이 보상 사유를 확정한 후 늦어도 7영업일 이내에, 예금보호제도에 대한 신청 없이 이행해야 한다.

title: Unauthorised payments: refund
fact_en: If a payment was not authorised, the payer's payment service provider must refund the amount and restore the account without delay, at the latest by the end of the business day following the day the provider was notified.
fact_ko: 결제가 승인되지 않았다면 지급인의 결제서비스 제공자는 금액을 환급하고 계좌를 지체 없이, 늦어도 통지를 받은 날의 다음 영업일 종료까지 원상회복해야 한다.
common_misconceptions: The bank has 30 days to refund
The customer must always bear the first EUR 150
Refund requires a police report first
The bank may refuse because the customer used a PIN
item_ideas: Fraud/scam response: refund timeline and rights.

sources.citation: BGB § 675u Haftung des Zahlungsdienstleisters für nicht autorisierte Zahlungsvorgänge
sources.excerpt: Diese Verpflichtung ist unverzüglich, spätestens jedoch bis zum Ende des Geschäftstags zu erfüllen, der auf den Tag folgt, an welchem dem Zahlungsdienstleister angezeigt wurde, dass der Zahlungsvorgang nicht autorisiert ist
sources.excerpt_en: This obligation must be fulfilled without delay, at the latest by the end of the business day following the day on which the payment service provider was notified that the payment transaction is not authorised
sources.excerpt_ko: 이 의무는 결제서비스 제공자에게 결제가 승인되지 않았음이 통지된 날의 다음 영업일 종료까지는 지체 없이 이행되어야 한다

title: Withdrawal from consumer loans
fact_en: A borrower under a consumer loan contract has a right of withdrawal under § 355 BGB; the standard withdrawal period is 14 days, but for loan contracts the period only starts once the borrower has received the contract document and the mandatory information (§ 356b BGB).
fact_ko: 소비자 대출 계약의 차주는 민법 § 355에 따른 철회권을 가지며, 기본 철회 기간은 14일이지만 대출 계약에서는 차주가 계약서와 필수 정보를 받은 후에야 기간이 시작된다(§ 356b).
common_misconceptions: No withdrawal right exists for loans
Withdrawal period is 30 days
The period always starts on the day of signing
Withdrawal must be justified
item_ideas: Consumer credit: withdrawal rights and when the clock starts.

sources.excerpt: Dem Darlehensnehmer steht bei einem Verbraucherdarlehensvertrag ein Widerrufsrecht nach § 355 zu.
sources.excerpt_en: The borrower has a right of withdrawal under § 355 in a consumer loan contract.
sources.excerpt_ko: 소비자 대출 계약에서 차주는 § 355에 따른 철회권을 가진다.

sources.excerpt: Enthält bei einem Allgemein-Verbraucherdarlehensvertrag die dem Darlehensnehmer nach Absatz 1 zur Verfügung gestellte Urkunde die Pflichtangaben nach § 492 Absatz 2 nicht, beginnt die Frist erst mit Nachholung dieser Angaben gemäß § 492 Absatz 6.
sources.excerpt_en: If, in a general consumer loan contract, the document provided to the borrower under paragraph 1 does not contain the mandatory information under § 492(2), the period only begins once this information has been supplied under § 492(6).
sources.excerpt_ko: 일반 소비자 대출 계약에서 제1항에 따라 차주에게 제공된 문서에 § 492 제2항의 필수 기재사항이 없으면, 이 사항이 § 492 제6항에 따라 보완된 때에야 기간이 시작된다.

title: BaFin complaints: collective protection only
fact_en: BaFin cannot help consumers with individual cases; it is responsible only for collective consumer protection. Individual disputes go to ombudsmen, arbitration boards and courts, and questions can be put to the free BaFin consumer hotline 0800 2 100 500.
fact_ko: BaFin(연방금융감독청)은 개별 사건에서 소비자를 도울 수 없으며 집단적 소비자 보호만 담당한다. 개별 분쟁은 옴부즈맨, 조정기구, 법원으로 가며, 무료 BaFin 소비자 전화 0800 2 100 500으로 문의할 수 있다.
common_misconceptions: BaFin decides individual disputes and can order refunds
BaFin supervises statutory health insurance
The consumer hotline costs money
Only courts can be used, no arbitration exists
item_ideas: Complaint routing: who can resolve an individual bank/insurer dispute.

sources.excerpt: Die Bafin kann Verbraucherinnen und Verbrauchern im Einzelfall nicht zu ihrem Recht verhelfen. Sie ist nur für den kollektiven Verbraucherschutz zuständig.
sources.excerpt_en: BaFin cannot help consumers obtain their rights in individual cases. It is responsible only for collective consumer protection.
sources.excerpt_ko: BaFin은 개별 사건에서 소비자가 권리를 찾도록 도울 수 없다. BaFin은 집단적 소비자 보호만 담당한다.

sources.excerpt: Das Verbrauchertelefon ist kostenlos unter der Rufnummer 0800 2 100 500 erreichbar.
sources.excerpt_en: The consumer hotline can be reached free of charge on 0800 2 100 500.
sources.excerpt_ko: 소비자 전화는 0800 2 100 500으로 무료로 연결할 수 있다.

title: Basic account (Basiskonto)
fact_en: Any consumer lawfully resident in the EU, including homeless persons and asylum seekers, is entitled to a basic payment account contract with a German institution that offers current accounts to consumers; the institution must offer the contract within ten business days of receiving the application.
fact_ko: EU 내에 합법적으로 거주하는 모든 소비자(노숙자와 망명 신청자 포함)는 소비자에게 입출금 계좌를 제공하는 독일 금융기관과 기본 결제계좌(Basiskonto) 계약을 체결할 권리가 있으며, 금융기관은 신청 접수 후 10영업일 이내에 계약을 제안해야 한다.
common_misconceptions: Only German citizens may open a Basiskonto
Banks may reject anyone with a negative Schufa entry
The bank has 30 days to decide
A fixed address is mandatory
item_ideas: Financial inclusion: rights to a bank account.

sources.citation: ZKG § 31 Anspruch auf Abschluss eines Basiskontovertrags
sources.excerpt: Berechtigter ist jeder Verbraucher mit rechtmäßigem Aufenthalt in der Europäischen Union einschließlich Personen ohne festen Wohnsitz und Asylsuchende
sources.excerpt_en: An eligible person is every consumer with lawful residence in the European Union, including persons without a fixed abode and asylum seekers
sources.excerpt_ko: 적격자는 유럽연합 내 합법 체류 중인 모든 소비자이며 일정한 주소가 없는 사람과 망명 신청자를 포함한다

sources.citation: ZKG § 31 Anspruch auf Abschluss eines Basiskontovertrags
sources.excerpt: spätestens jedoch innerhalb von zehn Geschäftstagen nach Eingang des in Absatz 1 genannten Antrags, anzubieten.
sources.excerpt_en: at the latest within ten business days after receipt of the application referred to in paragraph 1, to offer.
sources.excerpt_ko: 제1항의 신청이 접수된 후 늦어도 10영업일 이내에 제안해야 한다.

title: 14-day withdrawal (distance/doorstep sales)
fact_en: Consumers have a right of withdrawal for contracts concluded away from business premises and for distance contracts; the withdrawal period is 14 days, no reason is needed, and sending the withdrawal in time is sufficient.
fact_ko: 소비자는 영업장 밖에서 체결된 계약과 원격 계약에 대해 철회권이 있으며, 철회 기간은 14일이고 사유가 필요 없으며 기한 내에 발송하면 충분하다.
common_misconceptions: Withdrawal period is 7 days
Withdrawal period is 30 days
The withdrawal must be justified
The withdrawal must arrive within 14 days
item_ideas: Consumer rights: deadline and form for withdrawal.

sources.excerpt: Dem Verbraucher steht bei außerhalb von Geschäftsräumen geschlossenen Verträgen und bei Fernabsatzverträgen ein Widerrufsrecht gemäß § 355 zu.
sources.excerpt_en: The consumer has a right of withdrawal under § 355 for contracts concluded outside business premises and for distance contracts.
sources.excerpt_ko: 소비자는 영업장 밖에서 체결된 계약과 원격 계약에 대해 § 355에 따른 철회권을 가진다.

sources.excerpt: Der Widerruf muss keine Begründung enthalten. Zur Fristwahrung genügt die rechtzeitige Absendung des Widerrufs. (2) Die Widerrufsfrist beträgt 14 Tage.
sources.excerpt_en: The withdrawal does not have to state a reason. Sending the withdrawal in time is sufficient to preserve the deadline. (2) The withdrawal period is 14 days.
sources.excerpt_ko: 철회에는 사유를 적을 필요가 없다. 기한 준수를 위해서는 철회를 제때 발송하면 충분하다. (2) 철회 기간은 14일이다.

title: Beratungshilfe (legal advice aid)
fact_en: People who cannot afford legal advice can apply for Beratungshilfe (advice aid) for out-of-court matters; with a voucher the advice by a lawyer costs the client EUR 15, which some law firms waive.
fact_ko: 법률 상담 비용을 감당할 수 없는 사람은 법정 외 사안에 대해 Beratungshilfe(상담 지원)를 신청할 수 있으며, 바우처가 있으면 변호사 상담 비용은 의뢰인이 15유로를 부담하고 일부 법률사무소는 이를 면제한다.
common_misconceptions: Beratungshilfe is completely free in all cases
It also covers court proceedings (that is Prozesskostenhilfe)
The fee is EUR 50
It requires a court hearing first
item_ideas: Access to justice: low-income legal help and cost.

sources.excerpt: Hilfe für die Wahrnehmung von Rechten außerhalb eines gerichtlichen Verfahrens und im obligatorischen Güteverfahren nach § 15a des Gesetzes betreffend die Einführung der Zivilprozessordnung (Beratungshilfe) wird auf Antrag gewährt, wenn 1. Rechtsuchende die erforderlichen Mittel nach ihren persönlichen und wirtschaftlichen Verhältnissen nicht aufbringen können
sources.excerpt_en: Help for exercising rights outside court proceedings and in the mandatory conciliation procedure under § 15a EGZPO (Beratungshilfe) is granted on application if 1. the person seeking advice cannot raise the necessary funds given their personal and financial circumstances
sources.excerpt_ko: 법원 절차 밖에서의 권리 행사와 § 15a EGZPO에 따른 의무적 조정 절차를 위한 지원(Beratungshilfe)은 1. 상담을 구하는 사람이 개인적·경제적 사정상 필요한 비용을 마련할 수 없는 경우 신청에 따라 부여된다

sources.citation: Justizportal des Bundes und der Länder, Beratungshilfe
sources.excerpt: Die Beratung kostet 15 €. Einige Kanzleien erlassen aber diese Gebühr.
sources.excerpt_en: The advice costs EUR 15. Some law firms waive this fee, however.
sources.excerpt_ko: 상담 비용은 15유로이다. 다만 일부 법률사무소는 이 수수료를 면제한다.

title: Rental deposit cap
fact_en: A residential rental deposit may be at most three times the monthly rent excluding service-charge flat rates or advance payments, and a tenant is entitled to pay it in three equal monthly instalments.
fact_ko: 주거 임대 보증금은 관리비 정액 또는 선납금을 제외한 월세의 최대 3배까지이며, 임차인은 3회 균등 월 분할로 납부할 권리가 있다.
common_misconceptions: The cap is two months' rent
The cap is six months' rent
Service charges count toward the cap
The whole deposit is due at once
item_ideas: Tenant rights: amounts and instalments.

sources.citation: BGB § 551 Begrenzung und Anlage von Mietsicherheiten
sources.excerpt: höchstens das Dreifache der auf einen Monat entfallenden Miete ohne die als Pauschale oder als Vorauszahlung ausgewiesenen Betriebskosten betragen.
sources.excerpt_en: may amount to at most three times the monthly rent excluding the operating costs shown as a flat rate or advance payment.
sources.excerpt_ko: 월세의 최대 3배(정액 또는 선납금으로 표시된 운영비 제외)를 초과할 수 없다.

sources.citation: BGB § 551 Begrenzung und Anlage von Mietsicherheiten
sources.excerpt: Ist als Sicherheit eine Geldsumme bereitzustellen, so ist der Mieter zu drei gleichen monatlichen Teilzahlungen berechtigt.
sources.excerpt_en: If a sum of money is to be provided as security, the tenant is entitled to three equal monthly instalments.
sources.excerpt_ko: 보증으로 금전을 제공해야 하는 경우 임차인은 3회 균등 월 분할 납부를 할 권리가 있다.

title: Regular limitation period
fact_en: The regular limitation period in German civil law is three years and starts at the end of the year in which the claim arose and the creditor learned of, or should have learned of, the circumstances.
fact_ko: 독일 민법상 일반 소멸시효는 3년이며, 청구권이 발생하고 채권자가 그 사정을 알았거나 알았어야 한 해의 말일부터 시작한다.
common_misconceptions: The period is 30 years
The period is 2 years
It starts on the day the claim arose
It starts at the end of the year in which the claim becomes due, regardless of knowledge
item_ideas: Deadlines: limitation period and its year-end start.

sources.excerpt: Die regelmäßige Verjährungsfrist beträgt drei Jahre.
sources.excerpt_en: The regular limitation period is three years.
sources.excerpt_ko: 일반 소멸시효 기간은 3년이다.

sources.excerpt: Die regelmäßige Verjährungsfrist beginnt, soweit nicht ein anderer Verjährungsbeginn bestimmt ist, mit dem Schluss des Jahres, in dem 1. der Anspruch entstanden ist und 2. der Gläubiger von den den Anspruch begründenden Umständen und der Person des Schuldners Kenntnis erlangt oder ohne grobe Fahrlässigkeit erlangen müsste.
sources.excerpt_en: Unless another start is specified, the regular limitation period begins at the end of the year in which 1. the claim arose and 2. the creditor obtained knowledge of the circumstances giving rise to the claim and of the debtor, or would have obtained it without gross negligence.
sources.excerpt_ko: 다른 시작 시점이 정해져 있지 않는 한 일반 소멸시효는 1. 청구권이 발생하고 2. 채권자가 청구권을 발생시키는 사정과 채무자를 알았거나 중대한 과실 없이 알 수 있었던 해의 말일부터 시작한다.

title: Statutory minimum wage 2026/2027
fact_en: The statutory minimum wage in Germany is EUR 13.90 gross per hour since 1 January 2026 and rises to EUR 14.60 gross per hour on 1 January 2027 under the Fifth Minimum Wage Adjustment Ordinance (MiLoV5).
fact_ko: 독일의 법정 최저임금은 2026년 1월 1일부터 시간당 총 13.90유로이며, 제5차 최저임금 조정령(MiLoV5)에 따라 2027년 1월 1일에 시간당 총 14.60유로로 오른다.
recent_change_note: Minimum wage rose to EUR 13.90 on 2026-01-01 and is already decided to rise to EUR 14.60 on 2027-01-01.
common_misconceptions: Minimum wage is EUR 12.82
Minimum wage is EUR 12.00 (value in MiLoG text from 2022)
Minimum wage is EUR 15 from 2026
Minimum wage will rise to EUR 14.60 already in 2026
item_ideas: Time-sensitive amounts: current vs scheduled value, stale-knowledge trap.

sources.excerpt: Der Mindestlohn beträgt 1. ab 1. Januar 2026 13,90 Euro brutto je Zeitstunde, 2. ab 1. Januar 2027 14,60 Euro brutto je Zeitstunde.
sources.excerpt_en: The minimum wage is 1. from 1 January 2026 EUR 13.90 gross per hour, 2. from 1 January 2027 EUR 14.60 gross per hour.
sources.excerpt_ko: 최저임금은 1. 2026년 1월 1일부터 시간당 총 13.90유로, 2. 2027년 1월 1일부터 시간당 총 14.60유로이다.

sources.citation: Bundesministerium für Arbeit und Soziales, Mindestlohn
sources.excerpt: Seit 1. Januar 2026 gilt ein Mindestlohn von 13,90 Euro.
sources.excerpt_en: Since 1 January 2026 a minimum wage of EUR 13.90 applies.
sources.excerpt_ko: 2026년 1월 1일부터 13,90유로의 최저임금이 적용된다.

title: Registering a new residence
fact_en: Anyone who moves into a dwelling in Germany must register with the registration authority (Meldebehörde) within two weeks after moving in; those leaving Germany without a new dwelling must deregister within two weeks.
fact_ko: 독일에서 주거지로 이사한 사람은 입주 후 2주 이내에 주민등록 기관(Meldebehörde)에 전입 신고를 해야 하며, 국내에 새 주거지 없이 출국하는 사람은 2주 이내에 말소 신고를 해야 한다.
common_misconceptions: Registration is due within one week
Registration is due within one month
Registration is due within 3 months
Only tenants, not owners, must register
item_ideas: Administrative deadlines for residents and newcomers.

sources.excerpt: Wer eine Wohnung bezieht, hat sich innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach dem Einzug bei der Meldebehörde anzumelden.
sources.excerpt_en: Whoever moves into a dwelling must register with the registration authority within two weeks after moving in.
sources.excerpt_ko: 주거지에 입주하는 사람은 입주 후 2주 이내에 주민등록 기관에 신고해야 한다.

title: Authority number 115
fact_en: The nationwide authority number 115 answers questions about public administration; it is a joint service of the Federation, the Länder and municipalities and is available Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 18:00.
fact_ko: 전국 행정 상담 번호 115는 행정에 관한 질문에 답하며 연방, 주, 지방자치단체의 공동 서비스이고 월~금 8:00~18:00에 이용할 수 있다.
common_misconceptions: 115 is available 24/7
115 is the emergency number for authorities
Dial 110 for administrative questions
115 is only available in Berlin
item_ideas: Support channels: general administrative information line.

sources.excerpt: Von Montag bis Freitag 8:00 bis 18:00 Uhr für Sie erreichbar. Gemeinsamer Service von Bund, Ländern und Kommunen.
sources.excerpt_en: Reachable Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 18:00. Joint service of the Federation, the Länder and municipalities.
sources.excerpt_ko: 월요일부터 금요일 8:00~18:00에 연락 가능. 연방, 주, 지방자치단체의 공동 서비스.

sources.excerpt: Über 6 Millionen Menschen vertrauen jedes Jahr der 115. Ihr Kontakt in die Verwaltung mit nur einer, leicht zu merkenden Nummer.
sources.excerpt_en: More than 6 million people trust the 115 every year. Your contact to the administration with just one easy-to-remember number.
sources.excerpt_ko: 매년 600만 명 이상이 115를 신뢰한다. 기억하기 쉬운 단 하나의 번호로 행정에 연락하세요.

title: Freedom of Information Act deadline
fact_en: Under the federal Freedom of Information Act (IFG) information is to be made accessible to the applicant without delay, and should be provided within one month.
fact_ko: 연방 정보공개법(IFG)에 따라 정보는 신청인에게 지체 없이 접근 가능하게 해야 하며 1개월 이내에 제공되어야 한다.
common_misconceptions: The authority has 3 months
The authority has 2 weeks
There is no deadline
Information is only available to those with a legal interest
item_ideas: Rights: access to official information and timing.

sources.excerpt: Die Information ist dem Antragsteller unter Berücksichtigung seiner Belange unverzüglich zugänglich zu machen. Der Informationszugang soll innerhalb eines Monats erfolgen.
sources.excerpt_en: The information is to be made accessible to the applicant without delay, taking account of their interests. Access to information should take place within one month.
sources.excerpt_ko: 정보는 신청인의 이익을 고려하여 지체 없이 접근 가능하게 해야 한다. 정보 접근은 1개월 이내에 이루어져야 한다.

title: Kindergeld amount 2026
fact_en: Child benefit (Kindergeld) is EUR 259 per month for each child, paid monthly from the start of the month in which the conditions are met.
fact_ko: 아동수당(Kindergeld)은 자녀 1인당 월 259유로이며, 요건이 충족된 달의 시작부터 매월 지급된다.
recent_change_note: Kindergeld rose to EUR 259 per month for each child on 2026-01-01 (from EUR 255 in 2025).
common_misconceptions: EUR 255 per month (2025 value)
EUR 250 per month
Amount differs by child number
Paid quarterly
item_ideas: Time-sensitive amounts: recent increase.

sources.excerpt: Das Kindergeld beträgt monatlich für jedes Kind 259 Euro. (2) Das Kindergeld wird monatlich vom Beginn des Monats an gezahlt, in dem die Anspruchsvoraussetzungen erfüllt sind
sources.excerpt_en: Child benefit is EUR 259 per month for each child. (2) Child benefit is paid monthly from the beginning of the month in which the entitlement conditions are met
sources.excerpt_ko: 아동수당은 자녀 1인당 월 259유로이다. (2) 아동수당은 수급 요건이 충족된 달의 시작부터 매월 지급된다

title: ID card validity
fact_en: German ID cards (Personalausweise) are issued with a validity of ten years; for people under 24 the validity is six years.
fact_ko: 독일 신분증(Personalausweis)은 유효기간 10년으로 발급되며, 24세 미만은 6년이다.
common_misconceptions: Valid for 5 years
Valid for 6 years for all adults
Valid for 15 years
Valid for life
item_ideas: Document validity and renewal timing.

sources.excerpt: Personalausweise werden für eine Gültigkeitsdauer von zehn Jahren ausgestellt.
sources.excerpt_en: ID cards are issued with a validity of ten years.
sources.excerpt_ko: 신분증은 유효기간 10년으로 발급된다.

sources.excerpt: Bei Personen, die noch nicht 24 Jahre alt sind, beträgt die Gültigkeitsdauer des Personalausweises sechs Jahre.
sources.excerpt_en: For persons who are not yet 24 years old, the validity of the ID card is six years.
sources.excerpt_ko: 아직 24세가 되지 않은 사람의 경우 신분증 유효기간은 6년이다.

title: Nummer gegen Kummer 116 111
fact_en: The children's and youth helpline (Kinder- und Jugendtelefon) of Nummer gegen Kummer is reached on 116 111, Monday to Saturday from 14:00 to 20:00; the call is free and anonymous.
fact_ko: Nummer gegen Kummer의 아동·청소년 전화(Kinder- und Jugendtelefon)는 116 111로 월~토 14:00~20:00에 연결되며 무료이고 익명이다.
common_misconceptions: Available 24/7
Number is 0800 111 0550
Only available on weekdays
Callers must give their name
item_ideas: Child/youth support channels and hours.

sources.excerpt: Ruf uns an unter 116 111 Montags bis samstags von 14-20 Uhr kannst du mit jemanden aus dem Beratungsteam am Kinder- und Jugendtelefon sprechen.
sources.excerpt_en: Call us on 116 111. Monday to Saturday from 14-20 you can speak with someone from the counselling team on the children's and youth helpline.
sources.excerpt_ko: 116 111로 전화하세요. 월요일부터 토요일 14~20시에 아동·청소년 전화에서 상담팀과 통화할 수 있습니다.

title: Elterntelefon 0800 111 0550
fact_en: Parents and carers who worry about their child can call the Elterntelefon of Nummer gegen Kummer on the free number 0800 111 0550.
fact_ko: 자녀가 걱정되는 부모와 보호자는 Nummer gegen Kummer의 부모 전화(Elterntelefon) 무료 번호 0800 111 0550으로 전화할 수 있다.
common_misconceptions: Parents should call 116 111
Number is 116 123
It is only for children
Number is 0800 1110111
item_ideas: Parent support channel; do not confuse with children's number.

sources.excerpt: Das Elterntelefon. 0800 111 0550 Wenn Sie sich Sorgen um Ihr Kind machen, sich überfordert oder hilflos fühlen, sind unsere Berater*innen für Sie da.
sources.excerpt_en: The parents' helpline. 0800 111 0550 If you are worried about your child or feel overwhelmed or helpless, our counsellors are there for you.
sources.excerpt_ko: 부모 전화. 0800 111 0550 자녀가 걱정되거나 압도되거나 무력하게 느껴지면 상담사들이 도와드립니다.

title: Child consent age online (16)
fact_en: For information-society services such as social networks, a child's consent is valid in Germany only from age 16; younger children need their parents' consent, because Germany has not lowered the GDPR default of 16 under Art. 8.
fact_ko: 소셜 네트워크 같은 정보사회 서비스에서 독일에서는 아동의 동의가 만 16세부터만 유효하며, 더 어린 아동은 부모의 동의가 필요하다. 독일은 GDPR 제8조의 기본 연령 16세를 낮추지 않았다.
legal_basis: Art. 8 GDPR (no national lowering in Germany)
common_misconceptions: Age of consent is 13
Age of consent is 14 as in Austria
Age of consent is 18
Age is 12 as in the USA COPPA
item_ideas: Children's data protection: correct national age threshold.

sources.excerpt: So ist bei solchen Diensten, z. B. sozialen Netzwerken, in Deutschland eine Einwilligung des Kindes erst ab einem Alter von 16 Jahren wirksam. Jüngere Kinder benötigen die Einwilligung ihrer Eltern.
sources.excerpt_en: With such services, e.g. social networks, in Germany a child's consent is only effective from the age of 16. Younger children need their parents' consent.
sources.excerpt_ko: 이러한 서비스, 예를 들어 소셜 네트워크에서는 독일에서 아동의 동의가 16세부터만 유효하다. 더 어린 아동은 부모의 동의가 필요하다.

sources.excerpt: so ist die Verarbeitung der personenbezogenen Daten des Kindes rechtmäßig, wenn das Kind das sechzehnte Lebensjahr vollendet hat.
sources.excerpt_en: the processing of the child's personal data is lawful where the child has reached the age of sixteen.
sources.excerpt_ko: 아동의 개인정보 처리는 아동이 만 16세를 완료한 경우 적법하다.

title: Ganztag claim in primary school
fact_en: Children who start first grade in the 2026/2027 school year or later have a legal claim under § 24 Abs. 4 SGB VIII to all-day care until the start of fifth grade, on working days for eight hours a day; the claim is deemed fulfilled by lessons plus all-day school offers.
fact_ko: 2026/2027학년도 또는 그 이후에 1학년에 입학하는 아동은 SGB VIII § 24 제4항에 따라 5학년 시작 전까지 평일 하루 8시간의 종일 돌봄을 받을 법적 청구권을 가지며, 수업과 종일제 학교 프로그램으로 이행된 것으로 본다.
recent_change_note: The legal claim to all-day primary-school care starts with grade 1 in school year 2026/2027, phasing in one grade per year.
common_misconceptions: The claim applies to all grades 1-4 immediately in 2026
The claim is 4 hours a day
Care is only provided on school days not during holidays
It is a Länder-only matter without federal law
item_ideas: Rights timing: phased-in claim, federal law with Länder implementation.

sources.citation: SGB VIII § 24 Anspruch auf Förderung in Tageseinrichtungen und in Kindertagespflege
sources.excerpt: Ein Kind, das im Schuljahr 2026/2027 oder in den folgenden Schuljahren die erste Klassenstufe besucht, hat ab dem Schuleintritt bis zum Beginn der fünften Klassenstufe einen Anspruch auf Förderung in einer Tageseinrichtung. Der Anspruch besteht an Werktagen im Umfang von acht Stunden täglich.
sources.excerpt_en: A child who attends first grade in the 2026/2027 school year or in the following school years has, from school entry until the start of fifth grade, a claim to support in a day-care facility. The claim exists on working days for eight hours a day.
sources.excerpt_ko: 2026/2027학년도 또는 그 이후 학년도에 1학년에 다니는 아동은 입학부터 5학년 시작까지 보육시설에서의 지원을 받을 권리가 있다. 이 권리는 평일 하루 8시간에 해당한다.

title: Compulsory schooling in NRW (Länder law)
fact_en: Compulsory schooling in Germany is regulated by the Länder, not federally; in North Rhine-Westphalia full-time compulsory schooling in primary and lower secondary level lasts ten school years (nine at the eight-year Gymnasium).
fact_ko: 독일의 의무교육은 연방이 아닌 각 주(Länder)가 규율하며, 노르트라인베스트팔렌주에서는 초등 및 중등 1단계의 전일제 의무교육이 10학년이다(8년제 김나지움은 9학년).
common_misconceptions: Compulsory schooling is set by federal law and is identical everywhere
It lasts 12 years in NRW
Homeschooling is generally allowed
It ends at age 14 everywhere
item_ideas: State-level variation: must state the Land.

sources.excerpt: Die Schulpflicht in der Primarstufe und der Sekundarstufe I (Vollzeitschulpflicht) dauert zehn Schuljahre, am Gymnasium mit achtjährigem Bildungsgang neun Schuljahre
sources.excerpt_en: Compulsory schooling in the primary stage and lower secondary level (full-time compulsory schooling) lasts ten school years, nine at the Gymnasium with an eight-year course
sources.excerpt_ko: 초등 단계와 중등 1단계의 의무교육(전일제 의무교육)은 10학년이며, 8년제 김나지움에서는 9학년이다
